s: puM, (daha + BAve GaY .) dahanam । BasmI karaRam । (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 30 । 23 । “tadaBAve ca nfpatiH kArayet svakuwumbinA । tajjAtIyErnarEHsamyakdAhAdyAHsakalAHkriyAH ॥”) aTa SavadAhaviDiryaTA, -- “gatprARaM jYAtvA puttrAdiH snAtvA annaM kftvA sTApayet । tato gataprARaM snApayitvA vAsasA sarvvaM SarIramAcCAdyAstIrRakuSAyAM BUmO dakziRASirasaM sTApayet । tato GftenAByajya, o~ gayAdIni ca tIrTAni ye ca puRyAH SiloccayAH । kurukzetraYca gaNgAYca yamunAYca saridbarAm ॥ kOSikIM candraBAgAYca sarvvapApapraRASinIm । BadrAvakASAM gaRqakyAM sarayUM panasAM taTA ॥ vERavaYca varAhaYca tIrTaM piRqArakaM taTA । pfTivyAM yAni tIrTAni saritaH sAgarAMstaTA ॥ iti cintayitvA punaH snApayet । vastrAntaraM pariDApya upavItamuttarIyaYca dattvA candanAdinopalipya karRanAsikAnetradvayamuKAtmakezu saptacCidrezu suptasuvarRaKaRqikAstadaBAve kAMsyAdiKaRqikA niHkzipet tato vastrAntareRAcCAdya vaheyuH । vahanakAle AmapAtrasTaM tadannArdDaM vartmArdDe tyajet ardDaM piRqArTamavaSezayet । tato'gnidAtA puttrAdiScitABUmO gatvA tadannArdDaM tilasahitaM piRqadAnetikarttavyatayA utsfjet । sA yaTA, -- gomayenopaliptAyAM BUmO pAtitavAmajAnuH prAcInAvItI kuSamUlena o~ apahatA surA rakzAMsi vedisada ityanena dakziRAgrareKAM kuryyAt tadupari kuSAnAstIryya o~ ehi prata sOmya gammIreBiH paTiBiH pUrvviReBirdehyasmaByaM draviReha BadraM rayiYca naH sarvvavIraM niyacCa ityAvAhya satilajalapAtraM vAmahastAddakziRahastena gfhItvA o~ adyAmukagotra pretAmukadevaSarmmannavane nikzva ityavanejayet । o~ adyAmukagotra pretAmukadevaSarmmannetatte'nnamupatizWatAM iti vAmahastagfhItAmapAtrAdannaM satilaM dakziRahastena gfhItvA kuSopari dadyAt । piRqapAtraprakzAlanajalena tadupari pratyavanejanaM tUzRAM ganDAdidAnaM sAmagetarezAntu nAvAhanamiti viSezaH । tataH puttrAdiH snAtvA citAM racayitvA tatra dArucayaM kuryyAt । tadupari vastradbayasahitaM dakziRASirasaM sAmagamaDomuKaM pumAMsaM nyaset । nAryyAstfttAnadehatvaM sAmagetarezAM uttarASirastvam । tato devAScAgnimuKAH sarvve hutASanaM gfhItvA enaM dahantu iti manasA DyAtvAgniM gfhItvA, o~ kftvA tu duzkaraM karmma jAnatAvApyajAnatA । mftyukAlavaSaM prApya naraM paYcatvamAgatam ॥ DarmmADarmmamamAyuktaM loBamohasamAvftam । daheyaM sarvvagAtrARi divyAn lokAn sa gacCatu ॥ iti paWitvA triH pradakziRIkftya dakziRAmuKaH SiraH sTAne dadyAt । strIdAhe naramityeva pAWaH na nArImityUhaH । tato dAhe vftte prAdeSapramARAH saptakAzwikA gfhItvA citAgniM saptavArAn pradakziRIkftya saptakAzWikA ekEkakrameRa citAgnO prakzipet । tataH kuWAreRa kravyAdAya namastuByamiti mantraM sakft paWitvA citAsTajvaladdArUpari saptaprahArA deyAH tamagnimapaSyadBirvvAmAvarttena snAtuM nadI gantavyA । nagnaM SavaM na dahet SavasambanDivastrAdi SmaSAnavAsicARqAlAdiByo dadyAt । sUtikAM rajasvalAYca vastrAntarAvftAM satilapaYcagavyaM jalapUrRakumBaM ApohizwIyavAmadevyAdiBiraBimantrya snApayitvA dahediti viSezaH । garBavatyAstu garBaM niHsAryya sTAnAntare niHkzipya tasyA dAhaH kAryyaH । tato jalasamIpaM gatvA puttrAdayaH prayogadAnABijYaM SyAlakAdikaM prArTayeyuH । udakaM karizyAma iti tena ca kuruDvaM mA cEvaM punarityaSatavarze prete kuruDvamevetarasmin ityuttare datte vfdDapuraHsaramavataraRaM jale । tataH parihitavastraM prakzAlya tadeva pariDAya prAcInAvItino dakziRAsuKAH o~ apanaH SoSucadaTamityanena mantreRa vAmahastAnAmikayA apa Aloqya ekavastrAH sakfnnimajyonmajyAcamya dakziRAmuKAstarpayeyuH । tataH o~ amukagotraM pretamamukadevaSarmmARaM tarpayAmIti sAmagAnAM prayogaH yajurvvedinAntu amukagotra pretAmukadevaSarmmannetatte tilodakaM tfpyasveti ekAYjalidAnamAvaSyakaM aYjalitrayadAne PalAtiSayaH । tataH punaH snAtvA jalAdutTAnaM bAlapuraHsaraM kAryyam । tataH sAdbale upaviSya, mAnuzye kadalIstamBaniHsAre sAramArgaRam । yaH karoti sa saMmUQo jalayudbudasanniBe ॥ paYcaDA samBftaH kAyo yadi paYcatvamAgataH । karmmaBiH svaSarIrotTEstatra kA paridevanA ॥ gantrI vasumatI nASamudaDirdEvatAni ca । PenapraKyaH kaTaM nASaM martyaloko na yAsyati ॥ SlezmASru bAnDavErmuktaM preto BuNkte yato'vaSaH । ato na roditavyaM hi kriyA kAryyA viGAnataH ॥ iti cintayitvA gfhadbAraM samAgatya nimbapatrARi dantEH KaRqayitvA SamI pApaM Samayatviti SamIM spfzwvA aSmeva sTiro BUyAsaM ityaSmAnaM padA spfzwvA agnirnaH Sarmma yacCatu iti agniM spfzwvA vfzaBacCAgayormmaDye sTitvA hyogitimantreRa dvAvapi spfzwvA gomayamudakaM gOrasarzapAMSca spfzwvA bAlapuraHsarA gfhaM viSeyuH । divA ceddAhastadA rAtrO grAmapraveSaH rAtrO cettadA divase । aSaktO brAhmaRAnumatiM gfhItvA kAlapratIkzaRaM vinA pravezwavyam .” iti SudDitattvam ॥
v: dAha

pu॰ daha--BAve GaY । 1 BasmIkaraRe “dAhaSaktiriva kfzRavartmani” raGuH “dAhAdUrdDvamaSOcaM syAt yasyavEtAniko viDiH” Su॰ ta॰ smftiH । “pAMSuvarze niSAM dAhe” manuH । SavadAhaprakAraH CandogapariSizwe ukto yaTA “durbalaM snApayitvA taM SudDacelABisaMvftam । dakziRASirasaM BUmO barhizmatyAM niveSayet । vftenAByaktamAplAvyaM suvastramupavItinam । candanokzitasavANga sumanoBirviBUzayet । hiraRyaSakalAnyasya kzitvA Cidrezu saptasu । muKyevyaTa piDAyEna nirhareyuH sutAdayaH । AmapAtre'nnamAdAya pretamagnipuraHsaram । eko'nugacCettasyArdDamardDaM zaTyutsfjedBavi । ardDamAdahanaM prApta AsInodakziRAmuKaH । savyaM jAnvAcya SanakEH satilaM piRqadAnavat” । “aTa puttrAdirAhftya kuryyAddArucayaM mahat । BUpradeSe SucO deSe paScAccityAdi lakzaRam । tatrottAnaM nipAtyEnaM dakziRASirasaM sUKe । AjyapUrRAM srucaM dadyAddakziRAgraM nasi sruvam” । GftAktasyAlpAvane viSepamAha varAhapurARam “dakziRASirasaM kftvA sacelantu SavaM taTA । tIrTasvAvAhanaM kftvA snapanaM tatra kArayet । gayAdIni ca tIrTAni ye ca puRyAH SiloccayAH । kurukzetraYca gaNgAYca yamunAYca saridvarAm । kOSikIM candraBAgAYca sarvapApapraRASinIm । BadrAvakASAM sarayUM gaRqakIM panasAM taTA । vERavaYca varAhaYca tIrTaM piRqArakaM taTA । pfWivyAM yAni tIrTAni saritaH sAgarAMstaTA । DyAtvA tu manasA sarve kftasnAnaM gatAyuzam । devAScAgnimuKAH sarve gfhItvA tu hutASanam । gfhItvA pARinA cEva mantrametamudIrayet” । om “kftvA tu duzkftaM karmma jAnatA vApyajAnatA । mftyukAlavaSaM prApya naraM paYcatvamAgatam । DarmADarmasamAyuktaM loBamohasamAvftam । daheyaM sarvagAtrARi divyAn lokAn sa gacCatu । evamuktvA tataH SIGraM kftvA cEva pradakziRam । jvalamAnaM taTA vahniM SiraHsTAne pradApayet । cAturvarRyezu saMsTAnamevaM Bavati puttrike!” । sAgnikadAhaprakArastu nArAyaRa BawwakftAntyezwipadDatO dfSyaH । 2 kupitapittejadehasantApaBede yaTAha pittakopakAraRamuktvA vidAhilakzaRe BAvapra “vidAhi dravyamudgAramamlaM kuryyAttaTA tfzAm । hfdi dAhaYca janayet pAkaNgacCati yaccirAt” । “asidDimatsu cEtezu dAhaH parama izyate” । “atidagDe dAhapAkarAgasnAvANgamarddaklamapipAsAmUrcCAH syurmaraRaM vA । pAkAnte ca galatAlvozWaSozadAhasantApAn janayati” iti ca suSru॰
m: दाह m. (fr. √ दह्) burning, combustion, conflagration, heat, KātyŚr.; Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh.; R. &c.
glowing, redness (of the sky, cf. दिग्-), Mn.; MBh.; VarBṛS. &c.
cauterizing, cautery (of a wound), Suśr.; Mālav. iv, 4
pl. N. of a people (v.l. for वैदेह), VāyuP. 1
a: दाहः — [दह्-भावे-घञ्] 1 Burning, conflagration; दाहशक्तिमिव कृष्णवर्त्मनि R. 11. 42; छेदो दंशस्य दाहो वा M. 4. 4; Ki. 5. 14. --2 Glowing redness (as of the sky). --3 The sensation of burning, internal heat. --4 Feverish or morbid heat. --Comp. --अगुरु n., --काष्ठं a kind of agallochum. --आत्मक a. destructive, having power to burn, combustible; Ś. 2. 7. --ज्वरः inflammatory fever. --सरः, --सरस् n., --स्थलं a place where dead bodies are burnt, cemetery. --हर, --हरण a. allaying heat. --(रं, --णं) the Uśīra plant.
दाह, दाहक, दाहन, दाह्य, — &c. See under दह्.

v: dAhaGna

na॰ dAhaM hanti hana--wak । dehadAhanASake OzaDAdiBede tacca caknada॰ uktaM yaTA । “SataDOtaGftAByaktaM dihyAdvA yavasaktuBiH । kolAmalakayuktErvA DAnyAmlErapi budDimAn । CAdayet tasya sarvANgamAranAlArdravAsasA । lAmajjenATa Suktena candanenAnulepayet । candanAmbukaRAsyanditAlavfntopavIjitaH । supyAddAhArdito'mBojakadalIdalasastare । parizekAvagAhezu vyajanAnAYca sevane । Sasyate SiSiraM toyaM tfzRAdAhopaSAntaye । kzIrEH kzIrikazAyESca suSItEScandanAnvitEH । antardAhaM praSamayedetEScAnyESca SItalEH । kuSAdiSAlaparRIBirjIvakAdyena sADitam । tElaM GftaM vA dAhaGnaM vAtapittavinASanam । PalinIloDrasevyAmbuhemapatraM kuwannawam । kAlIyakarasopetaM dAhe SastaM pralepanam । hrIverapadmakoSIracandanakzodavAriRA । saMpUrRAmavagAheta droRIM dAhArdito naraH” ।

v: dAhaka

tri॰ dahati daha--Rvula । 1 dAhakarttari “kzetraveSma vanagrAmavivItaKaladAhakaH” yAjYa॰ striyAM NIpi ata itvam । dAhikA “SaktiryaTAgnO Kalu dAhikA sTitA” brahma॰ vE॰ pu॰ । 2 vahnO pu॰ 3 citrake vfkze ca 4 raktacitrakavfkze pu॰ rAjani॰ । vahnO ca dAhikA Saktiratirikteti mImAMsakAH । tanmataM ca anumAnacintAmaRO atiriktaSaktivAdanirAse utTApya dUzitaM prasaNgAdatra diNmAtraM darSyate yaTA “syAdetat ISvaravat kAryyeREva SaktirapyanumIyate taTA hi yAdfSAdeva karAnalasaMyogAddAho jAyate tAdfSAdeva sati pratibanDake na jAyate ato yadaBAvAt kAryABAvastadvahnyAdAvamyupeya tena vinA tadaBAvAt yattadBAvAnupapattervyatirekamuKena SaktisidDiH । na cAdfzwavEguRyaM dfzwasANguRye tadaBAvAt tasya tadarTatvAt anyaTA dfQadaRqadvandvamapi cakraM na BrAmyeta । aTAdfzwavilambAdapi vilambo yaTA banDyAstrIprayoge, paramARukarmaRi, aDyayanatulyatve ekatra PalatAratamyamiti cenna adfzwavilambe hi na tannASAnutpAdO maRyapasAraRAnupadaM dAhABAvaprasaNgAt । kiYca niyamato maRisadBAve kAryABAvastadaBAve kAryyamiti dfzwatvAt maRyAdyaBAva eva kAraRam anyaTA kadAcit maRyAdyaBAve'pi tadaBAvAnna kAryaM syAt banDyA saMprayoge tu dfzwavyaBicArAdadfzwavilambAdeva vilambaH । adfzwaYca kvacit sAkzAjjanakam anyaTA paramparayA hetu rapi na syAt । na ca samaprajYayoH samaYca nirapavAdamaByasyatorekapragalBate nApara iti dfSyate । na ca sarvotpattimatAmadfzwaM nimittaM kAraRam agamyAgamanasADye suKe tadaBAvAt tadvinA'DarmAt suKaM syAt na DarmAt । etena sugamyAgamanAdutpAdyaM suKamapyuktaM taTA cAgamyAgamanakAraRatvena na sa DarmaH SyenApUrvavannizidDaPalakatvenAnarTatvAt । dAhapratikUlAdfzwAdeva tadaBAva iti cenna tasyottejakABAvasahitamaRyajanyatva tatra dAhArTino'pravfttiprasaNgAt tajjanyatve tatastadutpAdakAdeva dAhABAva iti niyamasyAdfzwena praTamopasTitIpajIvyatvAcca । patibanDakABAvahetutvasya tenAByupagamAt adfzwAt SOcAcamanAdeSca sADAraRasyAtrApyanvayaH syAt । aSucereva tadutpattO, SOca sati tadaBAvApatteH pratipakzasanniDApakasya tattve, adfzwe sati maRyaprayoge'pi dAhAnApattiH agrimakAla eva sanniDidarSanena tadasidDyaBAvAt । astu tarhyuttejakABAvasahakftapratibanDakABAvasyAnvayavyatirekAByAM hetutvam evaM ca kevalottejakasadBAve uBayasattye uBayABAve ca viSizwABAvo'numitohetuH pratibanDakatvaYca kAraRIBUtABAvapratiyogitvaM tacca maRyAdyaBAvatvena, na tu patibanDakABAvatveneti nAnyonyASrayaH । evaM pratibanDakatvABimatamaRyAdInAmaBAvakUw eva kAraRaM tena saRisadBAve maRyAdyaBAve'pi na kAryam । anatiriktABAvavAdimate ca vyavahArArTaM tatsTAnABiziktasya hetutvam । na cABAvI na kAraRaM, BAvavadgrAhakatOlyAt । dfzwaYca kuqyasaMyogABAvasya gatO, anupalamBasyABAvavijYAne, vihitAkaraRasya pratyavAye, nirdozatvasya vedaprAmARye janakatvamiti prAYcaH । mEvaM viSizwaM hi nArTAntaraM yena tadaBAvo'nugataH syAt kintu viSezaRaviSezyasambanDA iti tezAM pratyekABAvasya hetutve kvacit viSezaRasyABAvaH kvacit maRyaBAvaH kvaciduBayaM kAraRamiti vyaBicArAnnEkamapi hetuH syAt । syAdetat pratiyogiBedAdiva pratiyogitAvacCedakaviSezaRaBede'pyaBAvo Bidyate anyaTA pfTivyAM pratyekarUpABAve'vagate'pi vAyO rUpasaMSayo na syAt । evaYca yaTA kevaladaRqasadBAve, daRqapuruzasadBAve, dvayABAve ca viSezaRaviSezyoBayABAvaprayuktaH kevalapuruzABAvo'bADitAnugatavyavahArabalAt pratItisidDaH taTA viSezyasya pratibanDakasyABAve viSezaRasyottejakABAvasyABAve dvayABAve ca kevalapratibanDakABAvo viSezyaviSezaRoBayABAvavyApako'nugata eva dAhakAraRamastu । aTa viSezaRAdyaBAvAdeva kevalapuruzABAvavyavahAra ekaSaktimattvAditi cenna anugatavyavahArasyAnugatajYAnasADyatvAt SakteScAtIndriyatvAt । aTottejakaprayogakAle maReH ko'BAvaH? na tAvat prAgDvaMsABAvatu tayoH pratiyogisamAnakAlatvAt na ca SyAmo'yamAsIdityatra yaTA SyAmaDvaMsaprayuktaSyAmaGawatvena pakvaGawasya DvaMsaeva, taTottejakABAvaDvaMsaprayukta uttejakABAvatvena maRiDvaMsa eveti vAcyaM DvaMsasyAnantatve uttejakApanaye'pi dAhaprasaNgABAvAt । nApyatyantABAvaH, tasya kAdAcitkatvABAvAditi cet yaTA daRqopanayApanayadaSAyAM kevalapuruzABAva utpAdavinASavAn abADitakevalapuruzABAvatadaBAvavyavahArayorupapAdayitumanyaTA'SakyatvAt taTottejakopanayApanayaSfNKalAyAM pratibanDakABAvo'pi taTEva svIkaraRIyaH tulya nyAyatvAt । yadi ca saMsargABAvatrayavEDarmyAttatra nAntarBavati tadA turIya eva saMsargABAvo'stu na hi kxptaviSezabADe sAmAnyabADo, viSezAntaramAdAyApi tasya samBavAt anyaTA kxptAnAdisaMsargABAvavEDarmyeRa DvaMsI'pi na sidDyet vyavahArAnupapattiSca tulyEba sI'yamasmAkaM sagotrakalaho na tu SaktivAdaH । astu vA DvaMsaevAsO saMsargABAvaviBAge janyABAvatvena DvaMsasya viBajanAt na cEvaM vinASavattvena prAgaBAva eva saH pariBAzAyA aparyanuyojyatvAt । yadvA'tyantABAva pavAsO tasya nityatve'pi kAdAcitkapratItikAryyAnudayO pratyAsattikAdAcitkatvAt pratyAsattiSca viSezaRA BAvo viSezyABAva uBayABAvaSca taTEva viSizwAtyantABAvasattvAditi tanna yadi pratItaviSezaRAvacCedena vidyamAnasyEva viSezasya DvaMsaH syAt tadA kzaRarUpAtItaviSezaRAvacCinnatvenaM pratikzaRaM Gawasya vinASaH syAt iti kzaRaBaNgApattiH vidyamAnasya vinazwatve cApratIteH SiKA vinazwA puruzo na vinazwa iti viparItAbADita pratyayAcca na viSezaRABAve'pi viSezyaDvaMsaH SyAmo'yamAsIt puruza ityAdO saviSezaRe iti nyAyena viSezyavati SyAmakEvalyaDvaMsa eva pratIyate DvaMsasya DvasAnupapatteH na vidyamAnasya DvaMsaH । etenottejakasadBAve satyuttejakABAvaviSizwamaRerutpannaDvaMsasya
